result.instructions: Tools for InventoryMod, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which products are out of stock or below their minimum quantity in my warehouses?"; "What is the stock of SKU TS-BLUE-M in each warehouse?"; "List the purchase orders that are still open.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes InventoryMod data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run inventorymod_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run inventorymod_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run inventorymod_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. inventorymod_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: inventorymod_list_warehouses
tools.title: List warehouses
tools.description: List the warehouses (stock locations) of the workspace. Use a warehouse id in the stock tools. GET /api/rpc/warehouses/list.

tools.name: inventorymod_list_categories
tools.title: List categories
tools.description: List the product categories of the workspace. GET /api/rpc/categories/list.

tools.name: inventorymod_search_products
tools.title: Search products
tools.description: Search the product catalog with filters, stock status and sorting. Returns items and totalCount. GET /api/rpc/products/search.

isArchived.description: Only archived (true) or only active (false) products.

parentId.description: List the variants of one variant parent.

tools.name: inventorymod_get_product
tools.title: Get product
tools.description: Get one product by its id. GET /api/rpc/products/get.

tools.name: inventorymod_find_product
tools.title: Find product by SKU or barcode
tools.description: Find one product by its SKU or barcode. GET /api/rpc/products/getByCode.

annotations.title: Find product by SKU or barcode

tools.name: inventorymod_get_product_stock
tools.title: Get product stock in a warehouse
tools.description: Get the stock of one product in one warehouse: quantity, reserved and available. GET /api/rpc/balances/get.

annotations.title: Get product stock in a warehouse

tools.name: inventorymod_search_stock_balances
tools.title: Search stock balances
tools.description: Search stock balances per product and warehouse, with stock status filter and sorting. GET /api/rpc/balances/page.

search.description: Search by product name or SKU.

parentId.description: Balances of the variants of one variant parent.

tools.name: inventorymod_get_warehouse_totals
tools.title: Get stock totals per warehouse
tools.description: Get the total physical stock per warehouse. GET /api/rpc/balances/warehouseTotals.

tools.name: inventorymod_search_movements
tools.title: Search stock movements
tools.description: Search the stock movement history (receipts, issues, adjustments, transfers) with filters. GET /api/rpc/movements/page.

movementType.description: Movement type, as the API names it.

startDate.description: Start of the date range, in the format the API accepts.

endDate.description: End of the date range, in the format the API accepts.

operationId.description: Only the movements of one stock operation.

tools.name: inventorymod_search_sales_orders
tools.title: Search sales orders
tools.description: Search the sales orders with a search text and status filter. GET /api/rpc/orders/search.

status.description: Order status, as the API names it.

tools.name: inventorymod_get_sales_order
tools.title: Get sales order
tools.description: Get one sales order with its lines. GET /api/rpc/orders/get.

tools.name: inventorymod_search_purchase_orders
tools.title: Search purchase orders
tools.description: Search the purchase orders by number and status. GET /api/rpc/purchaseOrders/search.

status.description: Purchase order status, as the API names it.

tools.name: inventorymod_get_dashboard_summary
tools.title: Get dashboard summary
tools.description: Get the dashboard summary: product count, stock value, out-of-stock and low-stock items, and totals by category and warehouse. GET /api/rpc/reports/dashboard.

tools.name: inventorymod_create_product
tools.title: Create product
tools.description: Create a product in the catalog (needs a write key). Writes a new product; it does not change stock. POST /api/rpc/products/create.

minQty.description: Minimum stock level for low-stock alerts.

tools.name: inventorymod_update_product
tools.title: Update product
tools.description: Change the fields of one product (needs a write key). Only the fields you pass change. The kind is not changed here. POST /api/rpc/products/update.

minQty.description: Minimum stock level for low-stock alerts.
